name: [STW REWORK] Stardust Reborn
desc:
| Stardust Reborn |
- A JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Game, Inspired from Araki's manga series.

Note-Game Is On Beta Expect Alot Of Changes And More Content In The Future 

Moveset:
(some moves have a tap/hold variant)

Q - Summon
E - Rush Attack
R - Finisher Attack
T - Special One
Y -  Special Two
F - Super One
G - Super Two
H - Special Three
B - Special Four

Z - Run
X - Guard
C - Dash


Owned by k7 and chab
